methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: To mitigate this engineering effort, a universal energy data information model (UEIM) is developed and presented in this paper.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper develops a universal energy information model (UEIM) for standardising and communicating energy measurement data (EmIn) between heterogeneous field devices and energy-management applications via OPC UA/MQTT and existing energy profiles (PROFIenergy, Sercos Energy, CIP Energy). It is a data/semantic information-model (tool/software) design with no EnPI or EnB measurement-model content: no energy performance indicator, energy baseline, normalisation variable, functional form, or estimation/construction approach is presented. ISO 50001 is cited only as motivating context, so any EnPI/EnB mention is incidental.

paper_type.evidence_quote: the UEIM can be imported into the respective PLC or edge device development environment using a UEIM-specific NodeSet file.

stage1.notes: UEIM is a class-diagram information model plus OPC UA NodeSet / MQTT-bridge concepts to reduce engineering effort; measurands (energy, current, heat quantity, compressed-air flow) are transported/represented, not modelled into indicators or baselines. No empirical case; a demonstrator is left to future work.
